Privacy Policy

Information you share

The enquiry form asks for your name, company name, email address, phone number and a description of the support you need. Entries in the current form stay in your browser. When you contact us directly, we receive the information you share and any follow-up messages.

Website visits and cookies

The hosting service may receive technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you request. It may use those details to deliver the website, troubleshoot problems and protect the service. Globe Mitra does not currently add analytics or advertising cookies to this website.

How we use information

We use the details you share to answer questions, understand the work you need and discuss a possible engagement. If you become a client, we use relevant information to manage and deliver the agreed services. We may also keep records to document our communications and meet applicable legal obligations.

Who can access information

The people who handle your enquiry or engagement may access the information they need for that work. Providers that host the site or support our business communications may process information to provide their services. We may also disclose information when the law requires it.

Providers may process information in the countries where they operate. Where rules on international transfers apply, we use the safeguards those rules require.

How long we keep information

We keep enquiry correspondence for as long as we need it to respond and follow up. If an enquiry leads to client work, we keep the records needed to provide and document the agreed services. Contractual or legal recordkeeping requirements may affect how long we keep either type of record.

Information we handle for clients

During client work, we follow the agreed instructions and access permissions for the records a client makes available. If your request concerns information a client controls, contact that organisation.

At handover, we agree with the client which working copies to return or remove and which records they need to keep. We also agree who checks that access to the accounts and shared files used for the work has been removed. Read about Trust and Security for more on access and handovers.

Your privacy rights

Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to request access to your information, ask us to correct or delete it, or object to or restrict certain uses. Where we rely on consent, you may withdraw it. You may also have the right to raise a concern with the relevant data protection authority. We may ask for enough information to confirm your identity and locate your records.

Privacy contact and updates

If you’ve been in touch with us, send privacy questions or requests to your usual Globe Mitra contact. When emailing, use “Privacy request” as the subject and tell us what you’d like us to do. Include the email address you used for your enquiry if you have one.
